The first single off the album, "Soldiers," is dedicated to the United States Army.
Sinner (Drowning Pool song) | "Sinner" is a song by American rock band Drowning Pool and is from their debut album "Sinner".  Serving as the first track on the album, the song also was released as the third single from the album.
